title: The Lost Cartographer
description: Boss intro for the cartographer wraith at the bottom of the Backwards Warren. He drew the one honest line in a dungeon nobody was supposed to build, and resents having been made to map it.

lines: The corridor behind you seals. Ink-stained ribbons drift in a wind that isn't there.

lines.speaker: The Lost Cartographer
lines.text: You found the shortcut. Nobody finds the shortcut.

lines.speaker: The Lost Cartographer
lines.text: I drew it in on my last day, out of spite. The only honest line in the whole warren.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: So none of this was supposed to connect?

lines.speaker: The Lost Cartographer
lines.text: None of it was supposed to be BUILT. I was a cartographer, not an architect. They made me draw it anyway.

lines.speaker: The Lost Cartographer
lines.text: Let's see if you read the map better than they did.
